author: GameTrailers
description: A necromantic named Cyris leaves his homeworld for a strange odyssey through unknown realms, each one more horrible and bizarre than the next. Use your necromancer abilities to save the earth realm in this retro FPS filled to the brim with fantasy & mystery. Hell Worlds Reinvigorated is coming soon to PC (Steam) with a demo available now on Steam.
title: Hell Worlds Reinvigorated - Official Demo Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Homonculus is a first-person Metroidvania boomer shooter that blends classic gothic inspirations with cartoony whimsy! Master intense combat, defeat intimidating bosses, and save the land of Gartvaria from its blight. Homonculus is coming soon to PC (Steam).
title: Homonculus - Official Announcement Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: REVEREND: Surf 'n Sin is the follow-up you didn't expect. A spin-off to the cult game REVEREND, this first-person shooter builds upon the gameplay and mechanics of the original, whilst throwing the story off the deep end. Have we jumped the shark? Water puns. REVEREND: Surf 'n Sin is coming soon to PC (Steam) with a demo available now on Steam.
title: Reverend: Surf ‘n Sin - Official Demo Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: The daughter of Satan has seized control of Hell and destroyed Heaven itself. You are hiding among the last survivors on Earth.—but not for long. An insane journey awaits you: a journey into Hell itself, to slaughter every demon, undead and cultist you encounter. SATAN II is coming soon to PC (Steam).
title: SATAN II - Official Announcement Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: A Mörk Borg-inspired first-person shooter that combines brutal dungeon runs with narrative progression and a stylized hand-drawn 3D aesthetic. Unwelcome Guests is coming soon to PC (Steam).
title: Unwelcome Guests - Official Announcement Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Gravelord is a fast-paced boomer shooter voiced by a badass protagonist featuring hand-crafted levels filled with secrets and hordes of enemies to kill. Dish out some brutal carnage with powerful guns and collect Tarot Cards to gain even more killing power. Let's put the fun back in funeral! Gravelord is available now in PC Early Access.
title: Gravelord - Official Coming Soon Teaser Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out the Demo Overview trailer for Monster Hunter Stories 3: Twisted Reflection, an upcoming turn-based, story-rich RPG series set in the world of Monster Hunter. Befriend, raise, and battle with iconic monsters when Monster Hunter Stories 3: Twisted Reflection is available now on Nintendo Switch 2, PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, and PC via Steam.
title: Monster Hunter Stories 3: Twisted Reflection - Official Demo Overview Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out the play style of the newest character in Season Pass 5, Jam Kuradoberi, in this trailer for Guilty Gear Strive, an action fighting game developed by Arc System Works. Players can soon gain access to a new playable character with the Season Pass 5 as Jam Kuradoberi takes to the fight. Jam Kuradoberi is scheduled to be released on April, 9, 2026 with the Season Pass 5 of Guilty Gear Strive on PlayStation 4 (PS4), PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox One, Xbox Series X|S, Nintendo Switch, and PC (Steam).
title: Guilty Gear Strive - Official Jam Kuradoberi Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Watch the season 5 and 2.0 update for Guilty Gear Strive, the latest entry in the 2.5D fighting game franchise developed by ARC System Works. As part of the update, players have now have access to a newly participating character "Jam Kuradoberi," plus new special moves for select characters, and the introduction of a new "Counter Blitz" mechanic. Players can also look forward to the "Blazing Pass" system, allowing them to earn in-game rewards based on their in-game progression. Guilty Gear Strive is available now for PlayStation 4 (PS4), PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox One, Xbox Series X|S, Nintendo Switch, and PC (Steam).
title: Guilty Gear Strive - Official Season 5 and 2.0 Update Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Take a look at the New Character Reveal trailer for Under Night In-Birth 2 , an upcoming installment of the 2D arcade fighting game franchise developed by FRENCH-BREAD and Arc System Works. Under Night In-Birth 2 is available now for PlayStation 4 (PS4), PlayStation 5 (PS5), Nintendo Switch, and PC (Steam).
title: Under Night In-Birth 2 [Sys:Celes] - Official New Character Reveal Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Watch the 'Amazing Guardians' trailer for Marvel Tokon: Fighting Souls, a 4v4 action fighting game developed by Arc System Works. Players will fight with a variety of Marvel heroes from Spider-Man, Ms. Marvel, Star-Lord, Captain America, and a brand new charcater: Peni Parker, a brilliant and eccentric young scientist who pilots the powerful SP//dr mech suit and takes on enemies. Marvel Tokon: Fighting Souls, coming on August 6, 2026 for PlayStation 5 (PS5) and PC (Steam).
title: Marvel Tokon: Fighting Souls - Official Amazing Guardians Trailer
